title: Vouchers
summary: Promo codes at checkout and the Vouchers admin page. checkout.quote priority 20. Permission vouchers.

blocks.text: The quote filter writes itemDiscount, shippingDiscount, and plugins[tuucho-commerce-vouchers]. Loyalty (priority 30) reads that bag so wallet spend happens after the voucher. Disable the plugin to hide admin and checkout fields.

rows: Same pattern as loyalty: bag then extraLines

blocks.text: Bundled path: tuucho-config/plugins/tuucho-commerce-vouchers/ (public config.json, gitignored config.private.json, committed config.private.example.json). Merge matches kernel JSON (common then env, private or example). Boot does not overwrite Admin values. First launch loads files once when settings are still empty. Edit in Admin → Plugins → Configure, or Update from files / Import / Export there. Admin → Plugins Update all / Import all / Export all uses the same files (schema plugins only; no extra register).

items.description: number — public. Maximum characters a voucher code may have. Raise only if you issue longer codes.
string — public. Window:max for voucher attempts (for example 60s:10). Protects checkout from guessing.
boolean — public. Turn on only on a local shop while testing. Leave off in production.
